description: This Scala source file defines a trait 'MdcEntrySettable' that provides methods for setting and removing entries in a logger's MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context). It specifies how log context entries can be added, updated, or removed, with support for chaining and multiple entries at once.

methods.name: withMdcEntry
methods.description: Adds or updates a single MDC entry identified by a key and value; returns a logger instance for chaining.

methods.name: withMdcEntries
methods.description: Adds or updates two MDC entries specified by key-value pairs; returns a logger instance for chaining.

methods.name: withMdcEntries
methods.description: Adds or updates three MDC entries specified by key-value pairs; returns a logger instance for chaining.

methods.name: withMdcEntry
methods.description: Adds multiple MDC entries given entries; supports varargs for multiple entries for chaining.

methods.name: removeMdcEntry
methods.description: Removes an MDC entry identified by key; returns a logger instance for chaining.
